card.line: Greece is a land in southeast Europe that the prophets name as a coming power, and where Paul traveled and encouraged believers on his mission.

moments.title: Greece in Daniel's vision
moments.text: An angel explains that the shaggy goat stands for the king of Greece, and that the large horn between its eyes is the first king.

moments.title: The prince of Greece will come
moments.text: A heavenly messenger tells Daniel that he must return to fight the prince of Persia, and that then the prince of Greece will come. A rich Persian king will also stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.

moments.title: Zion against the sons of Greece
moments.text: God promises to make Judah like His bow and to rouse the sons of Zion against the sons of Greece. He makes them like the sword of a mighty man.

moments.title: Paul arrives in Greece
moments.text: After encouraging believers in the area, Paul comes to Greece and stays three months. When the Jews plot against him, he decides to go back through Macedonia.
